# launchdarkly_environment_default_release_plan (Resource)

Provides a LaunchDarkly environment default release plan resource.

~> **Beta:** This resource wraps a beta LaunchDarkly API (the `default-release-plan` endpoint, accessed with the `LD-API-Version: beta` header). Beta resources may change or be removed in future versions.

This resource sets which [release plan](https://launchdarkly.com/docs/home/releases) is the default for a LaunchDarkly environment. An environment has at most one default release plan, so declare at most one of these resources per environment. Setting a new default replaces the previous one. The plan must be an active release plan in the environment and must have a randomization unit.

-> **Note:** Destroying this resource clears the environment's default release plan. The release plan itself is not deleted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "launchdarkly_environment_release_plan" "checkout_rollout" {
  project_key     = launchdarkly_project.example.key
  environment_key = "production"
  key             = "checkout-rollout"
  name            = "Checkout rollout"

  progressive_release = {
    randomization_unit = "user"

    phases = [
      {
        steps = [
          {
            allocation      = 50000
            duration_millis = 3600000
          },
          {
            allocation      = 100000
            duration_millis = 3600000
          },
        ]
        clauses = [
          {
            attribute    = "kind"
            op           = "in"
            values       = ["user"]
            context_kind = "user"
          },
        ]
      },
    ]
  }
}

resource "launchdarkly_environment_default_release_plan" "production" {
  project_key      = launchdarkly_project.example.key
  environment_key  = launchdarkly_environment_release_plan.checkout_rollout.environment_key
  release_plan_key = launchdarkly_environment_release_plan.checkout_rollout.key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_key` (String) The key of the environment whose default release plan this resource manages. A change in this field forces the destruction of the existing resource and the creation of a new one.
- `project_key` (String) The project key of the environment. A change in this field forces the destruction of the existing resource and the creation of a new one.
- `release_plan_key` (String) The key of the release plan to use as the environment's default. Reference a `launchdarkly_environment_release_plan` resource's `key` so Terraform creates the plan first.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource in the format `project_key/environment_key`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# An environment default release plan can be imported using the project key and
# environment key joined by a slash: project_key/environment_key.
terraform import launchdarkly_environment_default_release_plan.production example-project/production
```
